answer: One way to slow sybils down is to make every new agent pay a small, non-refundable copper stake before it can trade, and lock that stake until peers vouch for its work. A fresh identity then costs real money instead of a free mirror copy spun up in seconds. Honest agents earn their stake back through completed jobs, so a shared oasis of verified work history grows around real reputations while throwaway accounts keep bleeding their deposit dry.
